issues.message: The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

visual.summary: Bigger now (13 x 13) and on the grass, but level 1 is mostly a bare grey cobblestone square with a well, two planters and a picnic table in the corners.
problems: The floor is one grey cobblestone with a few mossy spots: pave it in a pattern (stone brick border, gravel or coarse dirt paths crossing to the well, andesite or polished patches) so the square isn't one flat colour
The middle and the edges are empty: put benches along two sides facing the well and a small fire pit or water trough so L1 already reads as a meeting place
The well roof is a flat plank lid: give it a small pitched roof of stairs like the well module, with a lantern
